title: Casino engagements and retirement in 1964
summary: He then played small cabarets and casinos at Cannes, Chamonix and six years at Estragon, retiring in 1964 as dental problems from the camp made playing difficult.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Yes, uh huh. Then I -- "Bird" started, we started playing in different small cabarets, and things, and casinos.
Then I built my -- prospected the casinos. 'Cause I said that it's solid, you see. The casinos were solid, and I went back to Cannes, went back to Chamonix, and Estragon.

And there were one or two cabarets in Paris, that I played, now and then. I played three months and then would go away, and then come back for three months. And I kept on going until the last six years of my profession, until I retired.
I was at the Estragon casino for six solid consecutive years, which was pretty nice. And I decided, after that, -- I started to have -- not lip trouble, but dentures trouble -- that was on account of

not having dental treatment, while I was in the camp, and eventually my teeth started wobbling. And personally, I did not want to give a bad opinion of myself. I thought that I did pretty good so far, and I wanted to fade out, with leaving that impression, you see.
